dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Three hundred Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Huh, you find that expensive?

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: H—How about this, then. If you purchase this holy water I have here, it'll come with an extra mystical chalice!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Drinking the holy water through this chalice increases its effects greatly!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: So buy it, buy it now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Three hundred Mora's a bargain! Wait, don't go! Waaait!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Traveler, do you ever find yourself frustrated because of your lack of strength? Have you wondered what it would be like to have power beyond your wildest dreams?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Who am I? I am one who the God of the Spring has put here specially to make miracles happen for people just like you!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: You can call me Hopkins the Marvelous.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do I get this power...?

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Just drink this bottle of holy water and the God of the Spring will reveal divine mysteries to you!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Who knows, with any luck you might even get a Vision!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: And how could you not want a Vision? Just three hundred Mora for a bottle...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: This is the opportunity of a lifetime —a thousand lifetimes, even! You're just going to walk away from it? Seriously, listen...

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: AAAAAARGH!!! *heavy breathing*... That— that was terrifying!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Oh, um... I... I was having an epiphany from the God of the Spring!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Now is Hopkins the Marvelous' special time where I bask in the presence of the God of the Spring. So move along!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're just drinking normal spring water...

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: What? Nonsense! Hogwash! Claptrap!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: You see only the physical form. After passing through the hands of Hopkins the Marvelous, it is normal no more!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: If you don't believe me, buy this bottle and see for yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Okay... But you must never tell anyone about the things you saw here today... Or you'll incite the wrath of the God of the Spring!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: ...And um... also, how about if you don't tell anyone I'll give you a discount next time you're here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do I become more powerful?

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: See this holy water I have here? Drink just one bottle, and you'll feel rejuvenated and more powerful than you could've ever imagined, guaranteed! It might take a while for the effects to kick in though...
